scenes.summary: 開場與香香餐車進園（保留首圖）
scenes.prompt: Sunny morning at the clay car amusement park, pink donut food truck Xiangxiang and yellow drill excavator Aku on cobblestone near ferris wheel and roller coaster — match podcast cover composition exactly, donut sign 12:00, Xiangxiang cheerful kawaii face, Aku stern cool face with spiral drill bit and pink donut on hook

Pink donut food truck Xiangxiang parked with open side window showing shelves of pink strawberry, chocolate and rainbow sprinkle donuts, chalkboard sign reads noon sale, line of cute faceless clay cars queuing happily, festive amusement park background
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Xiangxiang pink donut truck match cover page 1 exactly — kawaii face, donut sign on roof, NOT zongzi. Queue of small clay cars only, each ONE face if named.

scenes.prompt: Inside food truck kitchen area, Xiangxiang worried at empty faucet with no water, cross-section hint of underground pipe blocked by gray stone, anxious expression, donut prep bowls waiting, tense but child-safe mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: same Xiangxiang design from scene 2. Show worry not horror. Pipe problem clear for kids.

scenes.prompt: Xiangxiang thinking then deciding to call Aku drill excavator for help, small thought bubble or phone gesture, other clay cars nearby looking nervous already, park setting
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Xiangxiang match prior scenes. Background cars faceless or tiny — focus on her decision moment.

scenes.prompt: Flashback-style illustration of Aku drill excavator looking intimidating — huge dark spiral drill bit, thick black tracks, stern thick eyebrows, rarely smiling, loud rumble motion lines — small clay cars shivering and hiding, teaching why they feel scared
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku match 阿酷鑽地車 portrait and cover — yellow body, black drill, cool serious face, pink donut on side hook. NO friendly smile here. Each vehicle ONE face.

scenes.prompt: Aku drill excavator arriving with dust rumble in distance, small clay cars hiding behind pink Xiangxiang food truck peeking out scared, Aku approaching calmly, dramatic but gentle children's book composition
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku and Xiangxiang both match portraits. Cars hiding behind Xiangxiang — only two hero vehicles with faces. Aku still cool-faced not angry.

scenes.prompt: Aku stopped, speaking politely with low gentle posture, one drill arm raised in courteous gesture, warning cars to stand back before loud drilling, Xiangxiang listening relieved, small cars stepping back safely
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku expression softer but still cool — kind eyes not scary. Match portrait drill and colors. Xiangxiang same pink donut truck.

scenes.prompt: Aku carefully drilling ground with spiral bit, earth vibrating, dirt clumps flying safely away from onlookers, focused concentrated expression watching the ground, underground stone being pushed aside, careful precise work
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku match portrait — yellow drill excavator, black spiral bit, tracks, stern focus face. Action dynamic but not violent. NO duplicate faces.

scenes.prompt: Water gushing happily from repaired pipe into Xiangxiang's kitchen hose, Aku stepping back proud but humble, small clay cars smiling in surprise realizing Aku is helpful not scary, sparkles and relief mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku slightly softer proud expression, still same design. Xiangxiang celebrating water. Background cars amazed.

scenes.prompt: Xiangxiang mixing bowl with flour milk eggs ready, broken mixer sparking or slumped sadly, Xiangxiang distressed, waiting cars drooping disappointed, donut dream in jeopardy
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Xiangxiang same pink truck interior/kitchen view. Broken mixer obvious. Sad but cute not tragic.

scenes.prompt: Aku rolling forward kindly offering to help, speech gesture explaining his drill can spin like a mixer and he loves baking desserts in spare time, Xiangxiang and crowd eyes widening in surprise
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku warm gentle eyes while still cool design — character turnaround moment. Xiangxiang hopeful. Match both portraits.

scenes.prompt: Aku transformed attachment — large drill bit becomes small whisk spinning gently in soft pink donut batter bowl inside truck, Aku speaking softly teaching slow mixing for fluffy dough, magical but believable clay style
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku arm with whisk attachment NOT drilling dirt — soft batter splashes. Gentle face teaching. Xiangxiang watching amazed. Same yellow Aku colors.

scenes.prompt: Hot fresh donuts on display tray — pink strawberry, chocolate glaze, rainbow sprinkle donuts steaming, Xiangxiang presenting proudly at noon, clock showing 12:00, warm golden light
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Xiangxiang happy proud face. Donuts colorful and appetizing clay style. Match truck design from prior scenes.

scenes.prompt: Neat single-file queue of cute clay cars at Xiangxiang donut window, orderly happy waiting, Xiangxiang serving through window, park festive background
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Xiangxiang serving window scene. Queue cars faceless or one-face each. Cheerful orderly composition.

scenes.prompt: Clay cars happily eating donuts with crumbs, Aku standing nearby looking cool but holding a tiny donut proudly, amazed expressions saying donuts taste amazing, warm lesson mood about gentle heart inside tough look
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Aku cool exterior but soft body language holding donut. Xiangxiang smiling. Match both portrait designs exactly. Each hero ONE face.

scenes.prompt: Clay podcast studio like ep-11: host Mami (馬米) warmly talking to children about not judging people by appearance after Aku's story, Bonbon (阿蹦) sitting beside her nodding, round wooden table with microphones, pink mug, ferris wheel and roller coaster playset background, gentle teaching mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Bonbon and Mami MUST match their canonical host portraits exactly — Bonbon teal hoodie yellow backpack red shoes; Mami pink top coral skirt long wavy brown hair. Story heroes smaller in background mural or shelf toys: pink donut Xiangxiang truck and yellow Aku drill excavator. NO random humanoid blobs. NO zongzi. Hosts are HUMAN clay children/adult, not cars.

scenes.prompt: Split composition: foreground small cute clay car bravely waving hello to a new cool-looking truck friend in sunny park; background inset or beside them Aku drill excavator with rare gentle subtle smile as positive role model; Bonbon and Mami hosts at table edge encouraging kids, heart and donut motif soft
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Bonbon and Mami match host portraits if visible. Aku match 阿酷鑽地車 portrait — yellow drill excavator cool face with gentle smile hint. Small waving car is faceless/simple ONE face only. Friendship lesson hopeful tone. NO food truck required this scene.

scenes.prompt: Cheerful closing at clay car amusement park: hosts Bonbon and Mami waving goodbye together with story friends pink donut Xiangxiang truck and yellow Aku drill excavator, ferris wheel roller coaster sunset, inviting kids back to chechecar park next time
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Bonbon and Mami human hosts match portraits — center or front waving. Xiangxiang and Aku match cover page 1 and scene 15 designs. Four characters clear lineup. Each vehicle ONE face. Human hosts NOT transformed into cars. Warm sunset goodbye.
